function.name: lookup_by_claim_number
function.description: Resolve a warranty claim number, ServicePower dispatch number, or HCP work-order number to the matching job. Your first tool when a warranty/CSC rep gives you a number. When match_count is 1, read the 'primary' object for a straight answer: customer_name, appliance_type, scheduling_status, scheduled_start, tech_first_name, parts_status, parts_eta_date, plus shortcuts been_out (we've already been on-site) and is_scheduled (it's on the calendar). Answer the rep's question directly from those. If match_count is 0, read the number back digit-by-digit before saying we have no record.

claim_or_dispatch_number.description: The claim, dispatch, or work-order number the rep gave you. Strip spaces. Examples: '49135689' (AHS), '22818' (work order).
